test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following features are associated with the Gothic architectural style?

options.text: Pointed arches and stained glass windows

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pointed arches and stained glass windows**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gothic architecture** is a European architectural style that flourished during the **High and Late Middle Ages**, specifically from the **12th to the 16th century**. It evolved from **Romanesque architecture** and was eventually succeeded by **Renaissance architecture**.
 
• The **pointed arch** (or ogival arch) is the defining characteristic of this style. Unlike the rounded arches of earlier periods, the pointed arch allowed for **greater height** and thinner walls by directing the weight of the structure more vertically.
 
• **Stained glass windows** were extensively used to fill large wall openings, made possible by the structural support of the arches. These windows, including the famous **rose windows**, were used to illustrate biblical stories and create a luminous, ethereal atmosphere inside **Cathedrals**.
 
• Other fundamental features include **ribbed vaults**, which supported heavy ceilings with a web of stone ribs, and **flying buttresses**, which were external stone supports that carried the weight of the high roofs away from the walls.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Domes and Minarets**:

 
 
• These are primary features of **Islamic architecture** and **Mughal architecture**, seen in landmarks like the **Taj Mahal** and the **Jama Masjid**.
 
 
 
• **Flat roofs with courtyards**:
 
 
• These are characteristic of **traditional Indian housing** and **Mediterranean architecture**, designed to improve ventilation and provide private outdoor space in warm climates.
 
 
 
• **Sloping tiled roofs**:
 
 
• Commonly found in **Vernacular architecture** within regions of high rainfall, such as **Kerala** or the **Konkan coast**, to facilitate efficient water drainage.
 
 
 
• **Historical Examples**:
 
 
• Famous Gothic structures include **Notre-Dame de Paris** in France and **Westminster Abbey** in London. In India, the **Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus** (CSMT) is a premier example of the **Victorian Gothic Revival** style.
